basic_info.description: This charming Spanish-style 3-unit in Prime Buena Vista Park Location offers a unique opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history in the coveted Buena Vista/Haight Ashbury neighborhood. Boasting three well-maintained units, this property presents a compelling investment opportunity. Architectural highlights include striking Spanish Colonial Revival architecture with a stucco exterior, arched doorways, and decorative balconies. Terracotta roof tiles add a touch of warmth and character. The unit mix comprises two studio units, one 2-bedroom unit, and two car parking spaces. While preserving the building's original charm, units might benefit from modern updates. The prime Buena Vista Park/Haight Ashbury location is known for its elegant Victorian homes, stunning views, and proximity to parks, shops, and restaurants. Easy access to public transportation and major thoroughfares adds to its appeal. Strong rental demand in this area and the potential for value appreciation in this highly sought-after location make this a substantial investment opportunity. This 3-unit building at 31-35 Frederick Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a piece of San Francisco history with strong investment potential.
